newsitem.title: UK: NatWest to pull back from some big lending.
newsitem.headline: NatWest to pull back from some big lending.

text.p: Large loans to companies and other borrowers will be one of the first casualties of a strategy at National Westminster Bank Plc's investment banking arm NatWest Markets, its chief executive said on Monday.
"The most obvious single example is some of the low-yielding, big ticket lending that we still do," Derek Wanless told Reuters.
But this did not mean NatWest Markets would withdraw from the loan market altogether.
"There's still a role for that if it is part of an overall relationship with a client which is profitable, but in isolation its a very low-yielding business," he added.
